mapper.select: SELECT sw.*, u.username AS author_name FROM sub_works sw LEFT JOIN users u ON sw.author_id = u.id WHERE sw.parent_work_id = #{parentWorkId} ORDER BY sw.created_at ASC
SELECT sw.*, u.username AS author_name FROM sub_works sw LEFT JOIN users u ON sw.author_id = u.id WHERE sw.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sub_works (parent_work_id, title, content, image_url, is_resolved, author_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{parentWorkId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{imageUrl}, #{isResolved}, #{authorId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE sub_works SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, is_resolved = #{isResolved}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sub_works SET is_resolved = NOT is_resolved, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
